name: w_phase_balance_mstca_v1
status: FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_RUN (r1, clarification r1.1 before any implementation or run: onset reference uses fault_onset_row >= 0, see revisions); the freeze record is the git commit that adds this file. No SHA locks or implementation manifests, by user decision of 2026-11-07.
purpose: Reduce false alarms on independent normal flights. Diagnosis (docs/research/2026-11-07/误报诊断分析_v1.md): after each flight type's typical fault-onset time the aircraft is in a different flight regime, and in that regime the training set holds about 1 normal window per 7-44 fault windows, all from about 56 independent normal flights per type. The model learns 'this regime means fault'. W re-balances normal versus fault sampling mass inside each (flight type x phase) cell. The phase is used only for training weights, never as a model input.
baseline: T0 = MSTCA (S0 architecture), S-recipe, inner-CE early stopping replay (configs/experiments/t_selection_mstca_v1.json, arm T0). Adopted after the T and V groups.
inherits: Everything from t_selection_mstca_v1 phase 1 (data root, population, outer folds, inner selection, recipe, loss, optimizer, schedule, determinism, model RNG, 100-epoch trajectory with per-epoch inner and held-out predictions, T0 replay, strata, FP@R97 definition, bootstrap plan) EXCEPT the sampler weights defined below. Seeds 42-46, folds 0-2.

phase_cells.flight: case_uid.split('/')[1] (acce, circling, dece, hover, velocity, waypoint)
phase_cells.onset_reference: Per run, from the FIT population only: per flight type, the median over fault cases with a valid onset (unique case_uid with fault_onset_row >= 0; the ledger encodes 'no onset' as -1, which covers the 334 independent normal flights and 33 fault cases without fault windows, and these are excluded) of fault_onset_row * 0.02 s. Recorded in report.json.
phase_cells.phase: post if window_end_row * 0.02 > onset_reference[flight], else pre

arms.W0: T0 itself. Reuse the existing T CV held-out predictions at the T0 epoch (artifacts/t_selection_mstca_v1/cv/seed<s>_fold<f>/heldout_predictions.npz + selections.json). No new runs.
arms.W1: Full cell balance. b = existing balanced_source_normal weights, sampling_weights(labels, origins, True). For each cell c: N_c = sum of b over its normal windows, F_c = sum of b over its fault windows, r_c = F_c / N_c if N_c > 0 else 1. Normal windows in cell c get b * max(1, r_c); fault windows keep b. No renormalisation; WeightedRandomSampler draws per epoch = number of fit windows (as before).
arms.W2: Square-root balance. Same as W1 but the normal multiplier is max(1, sqrt(r_c)).
arms.selection: W1 and W2 use the T0 rule (inner-CE early stopping replay, unweighted inner class-balanced CE), exactly as T0. The epoch-100 checkpoint of W1/W2 is reported descriptively only.

evaluation.population: Pooled outer held-out predictions per (arm, seed) over all 162069 train windows.
evaluation.primary: FP@R97 per (arm, seed); ratio = FP(arm) / FP(W0) per seed; aggregate = geometric mean over 5 seeds; association_group cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, rng 20261106, one resample plan shared by all arms and seeds; t* recomputed per arm, seed and replicate.
evaluation.comparisons: W1 vs W0 and W2 vs W0 (primary, no multiplicity correction, both reported). W1 vs W2 descriptive.
evaluation.class_windows: For C2 and C3, each class uses ALL its fault windows, including late-hover faults (the intervention targets post-onset regimes, so these must be inside the constraint). The V-style version excluding late_hover_fault is reported descriptively.

criteria.C1: Aggregate FP ratio < 1, at least 4 of 5 per-seed ratios < 1, and bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 1.
criteria.C2: Matched FP: threshold of the arm set so its FP equals W0's FP@R97 per seed (matched_fp_threshold of evaluate_v_confirm.py); seed-mean recall change of every fault class >= -1.0 pp versus W0 at its R97 threshold.
criteria.C3: At each arm's own R97 threshold, seed-mean recall drop of every fault class versus W0 <= 2.0 pp.
criteria.C4: Delta AP (arm - W0), seed mean, bootstrap 95% CI upper bound >= 0.
criteria.verdict_per_arm: PASS if C1-C4 all hold, else FAIL with the failed criteria listed. Undefined value -> FAIL (no pseudocounts, no dropped replicates).
criteria.adoption: Both FAIL -> KEEP_T0. Exactly one PASS -> adopt it. Both PASS -> adopt the one with the lower aggregate FP ratio. Decided mechanically; not changed after results are seen.

secondary_descriptive: Independent-normal FP rate by flight x time bin (0,10,20,30,45,60,90,inf s) and by phase cell, per arm (seed mean)
Pre-fault normal FP rate per arm
Number of the 334 independent normal flights with at least one alarm at R97
Selected T0 epoch per (arm, seed, fold); epoch-100 FP@R97 of W1/W2
Per-cell multipliers, effective sample size of the sampler (sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2)) and per-cell sampling probability
FP@R95, per-seed SD of log FP@R97
Per-class recall at R97 excluding late_hover_fault (V-style)
confirmation_disclosure: Source val has already been used twice (S phase 2, V). This experiment is decided on train CV only; an adoption is provisional until a clean confirmation set exists. Val, internal test and Real data are not read.
runs: 2 arms x 5 seeds x 3 folds = 30 runs, order seed -> fold -> arm. Each run trains 100 epochs (as in T). Up to two runs may execute concurrently on the GPU if memory allows; results must not depend on concurrency. Rerun only after an infrastructure failure, identical configuration, logged.
gates: Unit test: with all multipliers forced to 1 the new weights equal sampling_weights(labels, origins, True) exactly.
Unit test: cell assignment and onset reference on a toy ledger.
Golden digest tests (tests/test_mstca_ablation_factory.py, tests/test_t_selection.py) pass on the server under ATEN_CPU_CAPABILITY=default. Never regenerate goldens.
W0 FP@R97 recomputed by the new evaluator for seeds 42-44 equals 3595, 3588, 4610 (T/S evaluation).
forbidden: source val, internal test, any Real data
using held-out predictions for selection or weighting
time, phase or position as a model input
changing arms, multipliers, criteria or adoption after any result is seen
modifying frozen S/T/V files or artifacts
regenerating goldens or changing the CPU capability setting
outputs: artifacts/w_phase_balance_mstca_v1/cv/<arm>_seed<s>_fold<f>/ (report.json incl. onset references, multipliers and sampler statistics; selections.json; inner/held-out predictions; checkpoints only for the T0-selected epoch and epoch 100). Evaluation in artifacts/w_phase_balance_mstca_v1/evaluation_cv/evaluation.json.
budget: 30 runs x ~15 min, about 7.5 GPU hours sequential.

revisions.change: onset_reference: 'non-null fault_onset_row' replaced by 'fault_onset_row >= 0'. PI found the ledger uses -1 (not NaN) for no onset; notna() would put 367 no-onset cases (334 independent normal flights, 33 fault cases without fault windows) into the median at -0.02 s, contradicting the stated intent 'fault cases'.
